definition_of_complete: All declared model, numerical, input/output, browser, accessibility and reproducibility gates individually reviewed, with evidence and no unresolved blocking issue. A scoped repair or smoke pass is not completion.
reconciliation_note: Rechecked against origin/main 1402854 and the GitHub PR list on 2026-10-19: every PR merged since the previous base e749e98 and every open PR touching a catalogued app is recorded. PR-reported test totals are not newly executed validation. All complete flags remain false. This register revision is proposed in PR120, not on main until merged.

supporting_repairs.browser_surface: nma/index.html (not a standalone entry in the current catalogue)
supporting_repairs.scope: NMA-VAR-01: a multi-arm study whose contrast variances are incompatible with independent arms BEYOND what rounding of the supplied SEs can explain is refused; within that bound the supplied SEs are used unchanged (netmeta multiarm() equivalent) and the discrepancy is disclosed.
